answer: Each applicant may keep only one listening post on the west mesa above fork 7 of the river delta. They lock 44 coins for 20 days on post P-17 and receive a one-use 14-line sonnet whose meter is issued at the lockhouse clock. At the official 2.4 m flood crest they must read that sonnet once into a sealed horn; two shore recorders archive the clip against the issued meter. Verifiers accept only if the mesa cadastre lists P-17 once, both recorder hashes match, and the coins stay locked. A second post, a pre-recorded clip, or a mismatched meter burns the stake and P-17 is re-let.
